about_the_game:
Journey from town to town along a beautiful pixel art coastline, building your skills as a traditional Australian swagman along the way. Fish, cook, and bushcraft to survive, collect additional skills and gear from the locals in the towns you visit, and enjoy the serenity of a simpler life.

Follow the development of this game on YouTube! (follow the social links to my channel)

Feature Overview (partially completed and planned)

  • Procedurally generated terrain and ocean

  • Dynamic and realistic ocean tides

  • Immersive weather with survival consequences (a swim in the ocean could leave you wet and cold)

  • Ambient sounds and other audio captured in the Australian bush

  • Fishing, cooking, shelter building, and other survival mechanics

  • Skill levelling and unlocks

  • Gear unlocks

  • Towns

Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12+

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Hexa-core or better 3.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4+ GB VRAM GPU
